title: Nod: n8n's free AI that does your online chores
intro: Nod is a free, open-source app from n8n Labs. You tell it a job in plain words and it does it in your apps and on real websites, with its own browser. It asks before it acts.
reel: From the reel: Stop wasting an afternoon on forms and logins

tools.name: Nod for Mac
tools.what: macOS 14 or newer. Apple silicon download below; Intel version is on the GitHub page.

tools.name: Code and docs
tools.what: Everything else, including the Linux preview and how it keeps you safe.

sections.heading: Set it up
steps: Connect your AI: sign in with your ChatGPT Plus or Pro plan, or paste an API key from the provider you use.
Set a monthly spending limit. It also checks with you when a single job passes $5 (you can change that).
Connect the apps you want it to use, like Gmail, Calendar, Slack or Notion. Only what you need.
Give it a small job first, and read what it asks before you say yes.

note: It does the clicking. You still say yes.
